what: A 1px thin curve is left where the mouse passes — joined by catmull-rom in 5 subdivisions using the average of the last 5 points as control points, and each segment fades out over .7s power2.out after .3s. Within ±30px around it, 10px term words appear at 20% probability at 200~400ms intervals over .2s, then fade out over .8s after .8s. Over links and buttons or outside the element, the whole stage retracts in .2s. It uses difference blending, so it looks bright on a dark background.

options.words: Words to float, comma-separated (if none, [data-fx-part=word] child text, and with neither, only the trail)
options.chance: Chance a word appears on each move, default .2
options.spread: Max distance words fall from the cursor (px), default 30
options.gap: Minimum gap between words (ms), default 200 · gap-max maximum, default 400
options.hold: Time the trail lingers (s), default .3 · fade-out length, default .7
options.calm: Selector for the child that walks the stage there, default "a, button"
options.--fx-ink: Line and text color (via style), default --kf-ink

note: The stage is fixed to the screen (position: fixed), so if an ancestor of the attached element has a transform, it lays out relative to that ancestor. Does not attach on touch devices (hover false).

from.where: shared.js startGraphic (.qs-graphic — full screen on every page, links and buttons use data-graphic=safe) — two layers of the original Konva 9.3.22 (trail #232321 1px · word Noto Sans 500 10px)
